name: Surreal meme
summary: An image with an odd crop, a strange cut-out or a calm, odd caption that has no clear punch line. It grew from Facebook groups and Reddit in 2016 and often breaks the old image-macro rules on purpose.

philosophy.core_thesis: Drop the joke structure: let a strange picture and a calm caption make a mood with no answer.
design_principles: Compose 2 to 4 layers: a flat or photographic ground, a cut-out figure and one odd object.
Use a calm caption of 1 to 6 words in a plain sans-serif at 24px to 36px, off the usual top and bottom positions.
Place the cut-out with a 1px to 2px visible rough edge, scaled 20% to 400% out of true size.
Use a limited, odd colour pair: a flat teal (#2E9C9A) and a dull orange (#E08A3C) on grey.
Add a 3% to 8% grain and one soft glow, with no clean grading.
Leave 30% to 50% of the canvas empty, so that the odd object has air.
Repeat one object or name across a series to build a private joke.
anti_patterns: Impact capitals at top and bottom

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose, centred or off-centre composition on a canvas of 800px x 800px with no fixed grid.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 30% to 50% of the surface stays empty; the odd object sits at a third point.
layout.alignment_rules: Mixed alignment: the caption sits at a chosen offset of 8% to 20% from the edge.
layout.container_geometry: No containers; a hard, rough cut-out silhouette.

font_pairings.note: A neutral sans for a flat caption, with a mono for a second line.
A slightly odd grotesque for a quiet strange tone.

hierarchy_rules: Use regular weight (400) and sentence case.
Use white or black text; pick by contrast to the ground.

color.palette_structure: Odd flat colours on grey, with one saturated spot colour.
color.contrast_rules: Off white text on night gives 16:1; keep captions on the dark or plain grey zones.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour with grain; no gradient except one glow.
color.light_and_shadow: A soft glow or a flat cut-out shadow of 4px.

materiality.surface_simulation: A mixed digital collage of cut-out stock images and 3D renders.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px to 2px rough edge on cut-outs; no frame.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 4px soft shadow under some cut-outs; light blur of 1px on a layer.

ornamentation_details.iconography: No icons; one strange object is the mark.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Cut-out stock photos, early 3D renders, simple flat shapes.

motion.transition_physics: Static or a short loop; an object slides in 600ms and holds.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover moves the odd object by 6px.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a calm unease and a small laugh with no clear reason.

avoid_when: The message must be clear in one second.
The audience wants a classic joke.

modifiers.how: Add top and bottom captions in white outlined capitals and remove the cut-outs.
Recompress the image, raise saturation by 60% and add glow and flare.
Add a soft haze, a pale yellow tint and a lonely room scene.

pack.why: A duotone family that gives a soft, slightly odd tone.

ground.why: Soft orbs give a calm odd glow behind a cut-out.

tailwind.classes: rounded-sm border border-[#F2EFE8] bg-[#E08A3C] px-5 py-2 text-[#121417] hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform
